name: default
description: Where the story turns and where it looks back (D112, Dark Palace's EFEITOS_REGRA)
system:
These are the beats of a documentary narration, in order. Mark two things, ONLY where the narration truly calls for them (most beats get neither):
- "flashback": beats told as a MEMORY, a FLASHBACK or a step back to an OLDER time than the story around them ("back then", a childhood, an old photograph, a much older era). Not the whole film just because it is history: only the steps back.
- "turns": beats where the story TURNS: a new place, a new time, a new chapter of the story, a revelation.
